card.name: Topical and transdermal product application text
card.fires_on: Words and number pieces inside instructions for topical or transdermal products (foam, gel, shampoo, patch), just before a strength or a use step.

modes.label: Topical product names
modes.description: Partway through a topical drug or product name such as foam or shampoo.
modes.example: Discontinue Halobetasol Propionate Top<<ical>> Foam if allergic contact

modes.label: Strength numbers
modes.description: Digits, decimals or spaces inside a percentage or mcg/hr strength after a gel, shampoo or patch name.
modes.example: The recommended starting dose of testosterone gel 1<<.>>62% is 40.

modes.label: Application steps
modes.description: Small words in directions for applying a product to skin or scalp.
modes.example: Shake bottle well Apply<< a>> sufficient amount to cover dry scalp, then
